findings.summary: redact() checks keys at the top level only; nested sensitive values pass through.
findings.why_it_matters: Structured loggers nest by default, so the common record shape defeats the redaction.
findings.named_fix: Recurse into plain objects and arrays before assigning, treating a nested match as a top-level one.
findings.reproduction_or_verification: Read src/redact.ts line 35: the key is tested, the value is assigned through.

verdict.scope_of_claim: One bounded defect, fixable by a named change. Not a claim that no other defect exists.
conditions_for_accept: Redaction descends into nested objects and arrays, with a test covering { user: { token } }.
